summary: First test iteration for Tredev Learn MVP. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass (auth for all 5 seeded roles, offerings CRUD+filter, verses/shloka-of-day, sadhana flow w/ mock payment+webhook, all 5 calculators, consultation consent+load-balancing, certificate issue+public verify, RBAC for admin/audit endpoints, admin cannot appoint super_admin, staff→acharya approval flow, community read/write, live sessions mocked join). Frontend: landing renders full hero + Shloka-of-day + tracks + featured; courses page shows 7 offerings; verify page returns 'Not found' for bad code; calculators has all 5 tabs; consultation correctly rejects without consent and succeeds with consent; login for learner routes to /learner, admin routes to /admin with all 4 admin tabs (Capabilities, Users, Publishing, Audit) visible; ShlokaPlayer testids all present. No critical bugs found.

issues: Unauthenticated pages trigger /api/auth/me returning 401 which prints as console errors. Not a bug (deliberate silent probe) but consider suppressing 401 for the /auth/me pre-check to keep the console clean.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1311 lines — a single monolith. For maintainability, split by domain (auth, offerings, verses, sadhana, consultations, certificates, payments, community, admin) into routers under /app/backend/routers/. Not blocking MVP.

PATCH /api/users/{id} logic: the role-validation guard only runs when role is NOT in the allowed list — this happens to work for super_admin, but a stray/invalid role string (e.g. 'god') would slip through the outer condition and be persisted as-is because the inner check is only for 'super_admin'. Recommend explicit whitelist rejection for any unknown role value.
PATCH /api/offerings/{id} accepts a raw dict body (no Pydantic model). Allows arbitrary field writes into MongoDB — consider a Pydantic model to constrain updatable fields.
PATCH /api/consultations/{id} similarly accepts raw dict — same concern.
Seeded live session starts 3 minutes after backend startup then expires. In production this pattern would degrade to 'no upcoming session' quickly. Fine for MVP demo.
CORS is fully permissive ('*' with allow_credentials=True and regex '.*') — for production, restrict to actual frontend origin(s).
Cookie is set with secure=False in login/register — OK for MVP behind HTTP proxy but should be True in production HTTPS.
test_credentials: See /app/memory/test_credentials.md — all 5 seeded creds verified working (learner/acharya/staff/admin/super_admin).
seed_data_creation: None (used auto-seeded data from backend startup). Test-created data prefixed with 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Covers all critical endpoints and RBAC. Note: super_admin appointment by admin returns 403 as expected. staff user's role in DB is 'academic_staff' (not 'staff'). Live-session upcoming may show can_join=false after ~3 min of backend startup — this is by design per problem statement. Frontend Playwright script covered landing, courses, verify, calculators, consultation (consent enforcement), login+role routing for learner and admin, and ShlokaPlayer testid presence.
